using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics.Metrics;
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Functions.Tests;

public class KernelFunctionFromPromptTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void CaptureUsageDetails_LogsWarning_WhenUsageDetailsMissingBothTokenCounts()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>>();
        var function = new KernelFunctionFromPrompt("test", logger.Object);

        var usageDetails = new AIResourceUsageDetails()
        {
            InputTokenCount = null,
            OutputTokenCount = null
        };

        // Act
        function.CaptureUsageDetails(modelId: "gpt-4", usageDetails: usageDetails, logger: logger.Object);

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAny<string>, It.IsAny<object[]>>((v, t) => v == "Unable to get token details from model result.")),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void CaptureUsageDetails_RecordsMetricsAndDoesNotLogWarning_WhenBothTokenCountsPresent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>>();
        var function = new KernelFunctionFromPrompt("test", logger.Object);

        // Mock the static metrics to prevent actual recording
        var originalPrompt = KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePrompt;
        var originalCompletion = KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletion;
        try
        {
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePrompt = new Mock<Counter<long>>().Object;
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletion = new Mock<Counter<long>>().Object;

            var usageDetails = new AIResourceUsageDetails()
            {
                InputTokenCount = 100,
                OutputTokenCount = 50
            };

            // Act
            function.CaptureUsageDetails(modelId: "gpt-4", usageDetails: usageDetails, logger: logger.Object);

            // Assert
            logger.Verify(
                x => x.LogWarning(
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAny<string>, It.IsAny<object[]>>()),
                Times.Never);
        }
        finally
        {
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsagePrompt = originalPrompt;
            KernelFunctionFromPrompt.InvocationTokenUsageCompletion = originalCompletion;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Functions.Tests;

public class KernelFunctionFromPrompt_CaptureUsageDetails_Tests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>> _loggerMock;

    public KernelFunctionFromPrompt_CaptureUsageDetails_Tests()
    {
        _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<KernelFunctionFromPrompt>>();
        _loggerMock.Setup(x => x.LogWarning(It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()))
            .Verifiable();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogsWarning_WhenUsageDetailsMissingBothTokenCounts()
    {
        // Arrange
        var usageDetails = new ResourceUsage
        {
            InputTokenCount = null,
            OutputTokenCount = null
        };

        // Act
        KernelFunctionFromPrompt.CaptureUsageDetails(modelId: "gpt-4", usageDetails: usageDetails, logger: _loggerMock.Object);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(x => x.LogWarning(It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), "Unable to get token details from model result."), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DoesNotLogWarning_WhenBothTokenCountsPresent()
    {
        // Arrange
        var usageDetails = new ResourceUsage
        {
            InputTokenCount = 100,
            OutputTokenCount = 50
        };

        // Act
        KernelFunctionFromPrompt.CaptureUsageDetails(modelId: "gpt-4", usageDetails: usageDetails, logger: _loggerMock.Object);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(x => x.LogWarning(It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DoesNotLogWarning_WhenMetricsDisabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var usageDetails = new ResourceUsage
        {
            InputTokenCount = null,
            OutputTokenCount = null
        };

        // Act
        KernelFunctionFromPrompt.CaptureUsageDetails(modelId: null, usageDetails: usageDetails, logger: _loggerMock.Object);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(x => x.LogWarning(It.IsAny<EventId>(), It.IsAny<Exception>(), "Unable to get token details from model result."), Times.Never);
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Functions.Tests;

public class LoggerExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void LogWarningExtension_CanBeCalledOnILogger()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();

        // Act
        loggerMock.Object.LogWarning("Test warning message");

        // Assert - No exception thrown
        Assert.True(true);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogWarningExtension_CapturesCorrectMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        loggerMock.Setup(x => x.Log(
            LogLevel.Warning,
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.Is<It.IsAny<string>, object?[]?>(state => state.ToString()!.Contains("Unable to get token details")),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAny<string>, Exception?, string>>()))
            .Verifiable();

        // Act
        loggerMock.Object.LogWarning("Unable to get token details from model result.");

        // Assert
        loggerMock.VerifyAll();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogWarningExtension_WithEventIdAndException_Works()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        var exception = new Exception("Test exception");

        loggerMock.Setup(x => x.Log(
            LogLevel.Warning,
            It.Is<EventId>(e => e.Id == 0),
            It.IsAny<It.IsAny<string>, object?[]?>(),
            exception,
            It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAny<string>, Exception?, string>>()))
            .Verifiable();

        // Act
        loggerMock.Object.LogWarning(0, exception, "Test warning");

        // Assert
        loggerMock.VerifyAll();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogWarningExtension_WithFormattedMessage_Works()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
        loggerMock.Setup(x => x.Log(
            LogLevel.Warning,
            It.IsAny<EventId>(),
            It.Is<It.IsAny<string>, object?[]?>(state => state.ToString()!.Contains("param")),
            It.IsAny<Exception>(),
            It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAny<string>, Exception?, string>>()))
            .Verifiable();

        // Act
        loggerMock.Object.LogWarning("Warning with {Param}", "param");

        // Assert
        loggerMock.VerifyAll();
    }
}
